epics.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate across falsification cycles
requirements: R1: Stop hallucinating pattern ID 'MAYKL_DAMIT_01_CONVERSATION_MAXIM' and score '11.000018' in PR reviews, and properly store the philosopher-specific rule as a retrievable chunk.
R2: Stop hallucinating method names like 'getClaim' in PR review criticalReasons, ensuring agent output is true, relevant, and non-ambiguous.
R3: Ensure valid authenticated requests successfully reach their endpoint and return 200/201 instead of HTTP 401.
R4: Implement the missing Moodle LMS integration for SSO and Role Mapping.

slices.title: Resolve Complete Defect Batch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the defect resolution for this epic, I want to patch all self-falsification findings in a single slice, so that the CI pipeline passes completely.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR review generation task, When evaluating outputs, Then no hallucinated pattern IDs or method names are present.
Given an authenticated request, When the endpoint is accessed, Then the API returns a 200 or 201 status instead of 401.
Given a Moodle LMS user, When they log in, Then SSO and Role Mapping correctly assign permissions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero recurring findings in the next cycle
slices.definitionOfDone: All findings fixed in existing code. Error cases (like 400, 401, 403, 500) are handled gracefully by logging the context and returning structured error responses without suppressing them.
